channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: One of America's largest reservoirs just hit a record low
item.description: Lake Powell has fallen to its lowest level on record after an exceptionally dry and warm winter left the Colorado River Basin with little mountain snow.

item.title: The LHC just ruled out another hiding place for quantum black holes
item.description: Physicists searching through Large Hadron Collider data found no evidence that the machine has been producing microscopic quantum black holes.

item.title: Solar System's earliest solids formed from fire, not ice
item.description: Ancient iron meteorites indicate that some of the Solar System's first solid bodies were composed mainly of tiny heat-forged rock beads known as chondrules.

item.title: Humpback whale mother may have mourned dead calf for days
item.description: Researchers observed a humpback whale mother remaining beside her presumed stillborn calf for hours and possibly days off Australia's Gold Coast.
